title: Bootstrap the harness
description: The repository has the crew CLI, harness data files, architecture rules, linters, CI workflow and the documents every model reads first. This task exists so the harness validates itself.
acceptance: AGENTS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/CONVENTIONS.md and docs/PRD.md exist
harness unit tests cover lint, status, state transitions and architecture rules

title: Verify provider terms of use and record the integration decision
description: docs/research/provider-terms.md holds the research of 2026-10-09 (written by a research agent; the fetch tool summarizes pages, and the OpenAI and xAI terms returned HTTP 403, so those clauses are unverified). Re-verify the key quotes on the live pages, mark what stays unverified, and finish with the 'Decision:' line that says which providers and which integration modes (structured, terminal, api) the MVP enables by default, following ADR 0008.
acceptance: The quotes that the decision relies on are re-checked on the live pages, with URL and date
Clauses that could not be verified are labeled as unverified
The document ends with a line starting with 'Decision:' naming the MVP providers, the default mode per provider and the API-key fallback
Open items are listed: written confirmation from Anthropic, access to the xAI and OpenAI terms

title: Decide project name and license
description: Pick the definitive name, check the domain and the package/organization names, and pick the license (Apache-2.0 or MIT). Record it as an ADR and update the module path if the name changes.
acceptance: docs/DECISIONS/0004-name-and-license.md is accepted and states the name, the license and the reasons
A LICENSE file exists at the repository root and matches the ADR
If the name changed, go.mod, AGENTS.md and the docs use the new name
